notes: Nine new artistic fonts are built in, including Chinese brush and cartoon styles plus seven display fonts for headlines.

Ten new light solid colours and seven light premium podium backgrounds were added. Thirteen festival backgrounds now carry the festival name, for example Christmas, Halloween, Chinese New Year and Mid-Autumn.
The Elements tool now has a built-in sticker library with six categories, so decorations can be dropped straight onto the image.
The editor panel now fits the screen and scrolls properly, so the rotation slider at the bottom is always reachable.
